name: Dana Snyder
bio: Dana Snyder is an American actor, voice artist, and stand-up comedian. He is widely recognized for his distinct, high-energy vocal delivery across prominent animated networks like Adult Swim, Cartoon Network, Disney, and Nickelodeon and is best known for playing Master Shake on the Aqua Teen Hunger Force show, and the film Aqua Teen Hunger Force Colon Movie. Snyder can also be recognized as the voice of Gazpacho on the series Chowder, the voice of The Alchemist on The Venture Bros and Todd on G4's Code Monkeys.
